title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions Concerning Further Strengthening the Grassroots Basic Construction of People's Courts under the New Situation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Issuance of the Notice on Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of Basic-Level Infrastructure of People's Courts under the New Situation

Fa Fa [2011] No. 4

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Strengthening the Construction of Basic-Level Infrastructure of People's Courts under the New Situation are hereby issued to you for your earnest implementation in light of local conditions.

January 28, 2011

Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of Basic-Level Infrastructure of People's Courts under the New Situation

The construction of basic-level infrastructure is an important component of social construction and the foundation of the entire social management. The construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts is an important guarantee for people's courts to serve the overall situation, protect people's livelihood, and safeguard social fairness and justice. To meet the needs of the new situation, the following opinions are put forward on how to further strengthen the construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts.

I. The Significance, Objectives, Tasks, and Basic Principles of Basic-Level Infrastructure Construction

In recent years, the construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts has achieved significant development, the level and ability of judicial personnel in law enforcement have been greatly improved, and the material equipment and funding guarantees have been substantially enhanced. During the current and future period, deep-seated problems and superficial problems, legal issues and social issues in China's economic and social development will be interwoven, the causes of social conflicts, especially those involving people's livelihood, will become more complex, and the trend of high incidence and frequent occurrence will become more severe. Resolving social conflicts focuses on the basic level; advancing social management faces difficulties at the basic level; ensuring fair and honest law enforcement hinges on the basic level. The basic-level people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals, which are at the forefront of resolving social conflicts and disputes, will face more severe tests, encounter more complex problems, and undertake more arduous tasks.

1. Strengthening basic-level infrastructure construction is an inevitable requirement for effectively ensuring and serving the overall work of the Party and the state. Basic-level people's courts are an important part of the basic-level people's political power. Under the new situation, further strengthening the construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts plays a crucial role in fully leveraging the functions of people's courts, effectively safeguarding the security of state power, deeply advancing the three key tasks, better serving the overall situation and the people's justice, and maintaining good social order and a rule-of-law environment.

2. Strengthening basic-level infrastructure construction is a fundamental guarantee for smoothly advancing the scientific development of judicial adjudication. All work of people's courts must be implemented through the basic level. The construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts is the focus for enhancing the overall work level of people's courts and the key to safeguarding social fairness and justice. Only by strengthening basic-level infrastructure construction can people's courts fully perform their functions and effectively promote the scientific development of judicial adjudication.

3. Strengthening basic-level infrastructure construction is an important way to actively respond to the concerns and expectations of the people. Approximately 90% of people's courts' cases are at the basic level. Basic-level people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals have the most direct contact and closest ties with the people. Strengthening basic-level infrastructure construction means starting from where the people hope for improvement and reforming from where the people are dissatisfied, continuously enhancing the level and credibility of basic-level adjudication work.

4. Objectives and Tasks of Basic-Level Infrastructure Construction. Guided by Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of the "Three Represents," deeply implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to "taking adjudication work as the center, team building as the foundation, and material equipment as the guarantee," strive to achieve within three to five years a significant improvement in the level of basic-level law enforcement and case handling, a marked enhancement in the ability to resolve social conflicts, a notable improvement in the image of courts and judges, substantial progress in material guarantees, a significant increase in the support of science and technology, and a distinct enhancement in the vitality of institutional mechanisms, effectively playing the positive role of basic-level people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals in promoting social harmony, maintaining social stability, and realizing social fairness and justice.

5. Basic Principles of Basic-Level Infrastructure Construction

- Adhere to the leadership of the Party. This is the fundamental guarantee for the construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts to develop in the correct political direction. At any time and under any circumstances, we must unswervingly adhere to the leadership of the Party, consciously accept the leadership of the Party, firmly rely on the leadership of the Party, and always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee in thought, politics, and action.

- Adhere to the mass line. Firmly establish the idea of justice for the people, adhere to the mass line of everything for the masses, relying on the masses, coming from the masses, and going to the masses, always take the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the people as the starting point and foothold of work, ensuring that the basic-level infrastructure work of people's courts is firmly rooted among the masses.

- Adhere to scientific development. Firmly establish the concept of scientific development, correctly handle the relationships between realistic needs and long-term development, comprehensive development and key breakthroughs, self-reliance and social coordination, scale and speed and quality and efficiency, and strive to promote comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable development of the construction of basic-level infrastructure of people's courts.

- Adhere to accepting supervision. Firmly establish the concept of consciously accepting supervision, improve internal supervision and restriction mechanisms, actively accept supervision by the People's Congress, legal supervision, democratic supervision, and public opinion supervision, widely listen to opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society, and continuously improve and strengthen the basic-level infrastructure work of people's courts.

II. Based on Changes in the New Situation, Give Full Play to the Role of Adjudicative Functions

In basic-level infrastructure construction, adjudication work is the center. Based on changes in the new situation, we must strive to achieve new progress and new breakthroughs in ensuring and improving people's livelihood, resolving social conflicts, and promoting long-term stable and rapid economic and social development. Only by "resolving conflicts locally, at the basic level" can we build a harmonious society with "stability at the basic level, peace under heaven."

6. Further improve the quality of adjudication concerning people's livelihood. Closely monitor the impact of price increases and changes in housing loan policies on people's livelihood, lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes in the fields of labor and employment, social security, education, medical care, housing, and consumption, focus on protecting the rights and interests of vulnerable groups, make efforts to resolve group conflicts, and effectively safeguard the vital interests of the people. Carefully study legal issues arising in the work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, effectively resolve disputes such as migrant workers' claims for labor remuneration, sales of agricultural products, and rural land contracting, protect farmers' rights and interests, promote agricultural development, and maintain rural stability. Prudently handle cases involving the expropriation of rural collective land and the demolition of houses on urban state-owned land, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of land-expropriated farmers and demolished households.

7. Further facilitate litigation for the people. Improve functional settings, standardize work systems, and strive to build the litigation and petition windows into "windows for the people, civilization, harmony, and credibility." Consolidate and improve the direct case-filing mechanism of people's tribunals, and focus on solving the difficulties for litigants in filing cases. Give fuller play to the functional role of the simplified procedure system, carry out pilot work on the expedited adjudication mechanism for small-amount cases, increase the intensity of judicial assistance, make the exercise of litigation rights more convenient for the people, realize their rights and interests more timely, and make them feel judicial fairness and efficiency more truly.

8. Further leverage the advantages of people's jurors. Focus on absorbing personnel from different industries, genders, ages, and professions to ensure the breadth, representativeness, and mass character of the people's juror corps. Strengthen daily management, improve various work procedures, evaluation, and incentive systems for people's jurors. Improve the "random selection" working mechanism for people's jurors to better realize judicial democracy. Strengthen pre-service and on-duty training to improve the participation ability of people's jurors. Give full play to the unique advantages of people's jurors coming from, being familiar with, and representing the masses, to the maximum extent guide litigants to respect and voluntarily perform effective judgments, and continuously improve the credibility of judicial adjudication.

9. Further standardize the establishment of people's tribunals. In accordance with the requirements of "three orientations" and "two conveniences," adhere to the principles of science, pragmatism, and efficiency, combine the actual needs of adjudication work in the eastern, central, and western regions, and scientifically plan the restoration, establishment, and adjustment of people's tribunals. In areas where the township under jurisdiction is geographically remote and transportation is inconvenient, or where the service radius of the original tribunal is too large, economic activities in the area are relatively frequent, and the number of cases accepted is relatively high, establish or restore people's tribunals. For people's tribunals where the need for establishment is not high due to convenient transportation or a low number of cases accepted, timely adjustments should be made.

10. Further expand the effect of circuit trials. In light of local conditions, earnestly implement the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Vigorously Promoting Circuit Trials to Facilitate Litigation for the People, effectively enhance the targeted nature of circuit trials, and strive for high quality and efficiency of circuit trials. Adopt various forms, rely on circuit trials to carry out extended services, promote the in-depth development of circuit trials, expand the radiating effect of adjudication work, and strive to provide fast, people-friendly, and comprehensive judicial services.

11. Further innovate adjudication management. Adhere to the concept of serving adjudication, establish a management system conducive to the healthy development of adjudication work. Adhere to a people-oriented approach, protect and stimulate the enthusiasm and creativity of adjudication personnel. Respect the rules of adjudication, scientifically design assessment indicators, pay attention to the typified and differentiated management of cases, and correctly evaluate the relationship between statistical data and adjudication performance. Rationally allocate adjudication resources, achieve the separation of complex and simple cases, and optimize the division of departmental responsibilities. Qualified basic-level people's courts should establish specialized adjudication management institutions, or allow the adjudication supervision division to undertake adjudication management functions.

12. Further expand supervision and guidance for lower-level courts. Make doing solid work and implementing effective supervision and guidance for basic-level adjudication work an important content of the daily work of intermediate-level people's courts and above and an important indicator of performance evaluation. Improve the mechanism for discovering, feeding back, analyzing, and solving problems; establish a risk assessment mechanism for major sensitive cases. Diligently carry out targeted investigation and research, comprehensively utilize systems such as requests for guidance on difficult legal issues in application, trial-level supervision, notification and analysis of reversed and remanded cases, and guidance from typical cases, broaden the channels for supervision and guidance, and continuously enhance the targeting, timeliness, standardization, and authoritativeness of supervision and guidance. Make great efforts to solve problems such as more guidance for individual cases but less summarization of types of cases, more ex-post supervision but less ex-ante guidance.

13. Further adhere to "mediation priority, combination of mediation and adjudication." Accurately understand and implement the basic spirit of "mediation priority, combination of mediation and adjudication," correctly handle the relationship between mediation and adjudication, and give full play to the combined advantages of mediation and adjudication. Accurately grasp the basis and conditions for using mediation or adjudication to handle cases. If mediation is permissible by law, suitable according to the case circumstances, or the effect of dispute resolution through mediation is better given the characteristics of the conflict, choose mediation to resolve the dispute. If mediation is not permissible by law, not suitable according to the case circumstances, or a judgment is more conducive to problem resolution, choose adjudication. Do not set mediation rate indicators out of touch with reality or force mediation or delay adjudication to promote mediation against the will of the parties, harming judicial authority and credibility. Take the automatic performance rate as an important standard, improve the evaluation mechanism that truly reflects the effect of mediation work, and better utilize the function of mediation to resolve conflicts.

14. Further promote the "grand mediation" working mechanism. Innovate and improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism linking litigation and non-litigation, actively promote the construction of a litigation-mediation docking center, and do a good job of pre-litigation mediation. In accordance with the requirements of not overstepping, not misplacing, and not missing, adopt various forms such as centralized training and systematic guidance, real-time guidance during circuit case handling, observation and guidance through trial attendance, and key guidance through typical cases, to improve the ability of people's mediation to resolve disputes. Improve the judicial confirmation mechanism for people's mediation agreements, standardize the judicial confirmation work of people's mediation agreements, and promote greater development of people's mediation work. Properly grasp the positioning of people's courts in the "grand mediation" pattern, give full play to the guiding, guaranteeing, and promoting role of the judiciary, while maintaining the independence and finality of judicial activities, also strengthen coordination and cooperation with all parties, forming a social conflict resolution force with clear role positioning and smooth procedural connections.

III. Comprehensively Strengthen Team Building in Accordance with the Requirements of the New Situation

In basic-level infrastructure construction, team building is the foundation. Building a basic-level team that is politically firm, professionally competent, wholeheartedly serving the people, fair and honest, is an important foundation and prerequisite for achieving the objectives and tasks of basic-level infrastructure construction.

15. Further strengthen Party building. Attach great importance to Party building work in basic-level people's courts and people's tribunals, seriously rectify problems such as incomplete organizations and weak laxity, adhere to building the team based on Party building to promote adjudication. Comprehensively strengthen the education and management of basic-level Party members, deeply advance the activities of "striving for excellence" and the thematic practical activities of "people's judges for the people," solidly carry out the thematic practical education activities of "carrying forward traditions, strengthening convictions, and enforcing the law for the people." Focus on cultivating, establishing, and publicizing the typical deeds of outstanding basic-level Party members, inspiring the work enthusiasm and motivation of the vast number of basic-level police officers. Improve the evaluation and assessment mechanism for Party member management, increase the punishment and sanctions for Party members who violate laws and disciplines, and enhance the shock and effectiveness of warning education.

16. Further strengthen the building of leading bodies. Earnestly perform the duties of cadre co-management, strictly control the qualification inspection of members of the leading bodies of basic-level people's courts. Through special training, judicial inspections, mid-term inspections, and participation in the democratic life meetings of leading bodies, strengthen the education, management, and supervision of leading cadres of basic-level people's courts. Explore the establishment of an assessment and evaluation system that reflects the Scientific Outlook on Development and a correct view of performance, which serves as an important basis for the adjustment, exchange, and use of basic-level leading cadres. Further improve and perfect systems for the adjustment, training, and use of reserve cadres, create conditions for the growth of basic-level cadres, and provide effective organizational and personnel system guarantees.

17. Further improve judicial style. Comprehensively inherit and carry forward the fine traditions of people's justice, run enhancing mass concept and feelings, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the masses, and maintaining close ties with the masses throughout the entire process of basic-level team building. Deeply carry out discussions on the mass viewpoint, adhere to a pragmatic and truth-seeking style, and conduct targeted self-examination and self-correction to minimize the occurrence of phenomena that harm the interests or feelings of the masses. Continuously broaden contact channels to promptly listen to opinions and suggestions from the masses, actively carry out activities to create people-satisfied courts and judges. Strictly comply with the provisions of the Basic Norms for Judges' Professional Ethics, the Code of Conduct for Judges, and the Basic Norms for Civilized Language of People's Courts, take standard and civilized justice as the core, and improve the code of conduct and normative system that is suitable for basic-level reality.

18. Further promote judicial integrity. In light of basic-level reality, solidly carry out the construction of a clean and honest Party conduct and anti-corruption work. Continue to carry out positive typical model education and negative typical warning education, explore new ways to combat corruption and promote integrity, and urge the vast number of police officers to be honest and self-disciplined. Earnestly implement the requirements of "four musts" and the provisions of "five prohibitions," improve working mechanisms such as accepting complaints through the internet, verifying clues of violations, and supervising major cases, improve the evaluation system and accountability system for handling cases, and always maintain a high-pressure stance against corruption. Advance the construction of a punishment and prevention system for corruption, earnestly implement the responsibility system for building a clean and honest administration, fully implement the system of integrity supervisors, improve the establishment of discipline inspection and supervision institutions at the basic level, equip them with adequate and strong discipline inspection and supervision personnel, and build a risk prevention mechanism for integrity that conforms to the laws of basic-level adjudication work.

19. Further enhance judicial capacity. Fully implement the education and training work policy of "one goal, two transformations, three advocacies," build a multi-form, full-coverage basic-level team full-member training system and network. Closely align with basic-level practical needs, continuously innovate training content and forms, include the ability to do and be good at mass work, master the skills of resolving conflicts and disputes, as well as the handling of emergencies, public opinion control and response, as compulsory content in the education and training work of basic-level judges and leading cadres of courts. Do a good job of the rotation training of basic-level judges, establish a regular rotation training system for presidents of people's tribunals. Organize, advocate, and encourage senior outstanding judges to conduct thematic lectures on adjudication, exchanges of judicial experience, and other activities. Improve the counterpart support mechanism for talents in the eastern and western regions, focus on cultivating and training young judges at the basic level front line, and improve the system for new recruits to gain experience at the basic level front line.

20. Further establish and improve the professional guarantee system and incentive mechanism. Seize the opportunity of the reform of the central judicial system and working mechanism, actively promote the establishment and implementation of the judge position sequence and its supporting policies, and appropriately increase the proportion of positions for basic-level judges. Appropriately increase the post allowance standards for basic-level case-handling personnel, further standardize and improve the working procedures and efficiency of special subsidies and condolence payments for judges (judicial police). Actively explore the establishment of a salary, retirement, and other subsidy system suitable for the characteristics of adjudication work. Care about the lives of basic-level police officers, make efforts to solve practical difficulties, implement systems such as paid leave and regular physical and mental check-ups, advocate healthy life interests, cultivate rational attitudes, and enhance the ability to "withstand pressure."

21. Further resolve the contradiction of more cases but fewer judges and the shortage of judges. Improve the unified provincial-level recruitment policy, persist in the work of selecting and transferring graduate students, and strive to broaden the sources and channels of judges. Standardize and strengthen the management, use, and supervision of personnel quotas, adhere to the policy and principle of tilting personnel quotas towards the basic level and front-line case-handling personnel, and promote the establishment of a personnel quota supplement mechanism that meets the requirements of the development of adjudication work. Increase the enforcement and supervision of central policies on early retirement and separation, optimize the team structure, leverage the role of resource allocation, reduce and eliminate the waste of adjudication resources. Actively collaborate with relevant state departments to study and improve the judicial examination method and improve the judicial examination policy. Expand the scope of the pilot project for the national unified judicial examination for in-service legal professionals, directly, quickly, and effectively solve the shortage of judges in the western remote areas and ethnic minority areas. Fully consider factors such as the language and culture and economic development of ethnic minority areas, formulate recruitment policies aimed at attracting local talents, guide, encourage, and support outstanding ethnic minorities and local Han talents familiar with the local language and adapted to the local environment to enrich the judge team. Increase the training of "bilingual judges" in ethnic areas, and actively study the establishment of a bilingual judge training base.

22. Further implement the strategy of gathering talents at the basic level. Earnestly implement the Central Committee's policy on basic-level work and talent work plan, formulate and implement a plan for the basic-level talent gathering project, introduce preferential policies for basic-level talent gathering, and improve the guarantee mechanism for basic-level talent gathering. Focus on selecting outstanding talents from the basic level, forming a new pattern of talent work where outstanding talents gather at the basic level, and outstanding cadres are produced, grow, and exercise at the basic level. Gradually establish and improve a system for selecting judges through merit and a selection mechanism conducive to the growth of basic-level police officers, and strive to expand the career development space for basic-level police officers. By 2012, the recruitment of civil servants by people's courts at the provincial level and above, except for some special positions, should be conducted from personnel with more than two years of basic-level work experience. Effectively solve the problems of "unwilling to go, unable to come out, and unable to stay," and make people's tribunals an important base for cultivating, training, and selecting leading cadres and professional backbones of courts.

IV. Adapt to New Situation Development and Vigorously Improve the Level of Material Equipment Guarantees

In basic-level infrastructure construction, material equipment is the guarantee. Vigorously promote the reform of the judicial administrative management system and working mechanism, straighten out the mutual relations between higher-level and lower-level people's courts in judicial administrative management, enhance the management responsibilities of higher-level people's courts, especially high people's courts, over lower-level people's courts in terms of funding guarantees, infrastructure construction, business equipment allocation, information construction, and judicial identification, and fully play the role of serving adjudicative functions.

23. Further increase funding guarantee efforts. Thoroughly implement the Opinions of the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council on Strengthening Guarantee of Funds for Political and Legal Affairs, and in accordance with the requirements of the Measures for Classified Guarantee of Funds for Political and Legal Affairs (Trial) issued by the Ministry of Finance, deepen the reform of the funding guarantee system. While the central government increases transfer payments, local governments should enhance their guarantee capacity and levels, so that grassroots units can truly benefit from the reform. The Supreme People's Court will continue to actively coordinate with central finance and the National Development and Reform Commission for funding and policy support to courts. Higher people's courts shall strengthen communication and consultation with provincial finance and development and reform departments, strive for the full allocation of provincial matching funds, actively participate in studying and formulating fund allocation plans, and cooperate with provincial finance departments in establishing a normal growth mechanism for grassroots public funding. Grassroots people's courts shall make efforts to communicate and coordinate with government departments at their own level, actively seek support from various sources, effectively implement local funding guarantee responsibilities, ensure the formulation and implementation of budget plans for people's jurors, hired personnel, etc., and guarantee various expenditures. Higher people's courts shall, together with finance departments, strengthen supervision, inspection, and guidance on grassroots funding guarantees and fund management, to prevent issues such as offsetting funds or reducing local investment.

24. Further complete infrastructure construction tasks. Under the guidance of the Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of Local Political and Legal Infrastructure and Standardizing the Investment Guarantee Mechanism issued by the National Development and Reform Commission, formulate overall plans and annual plans for the construction of trial courts and people's tribunals based on the actual needs of trial work. Carry out project application work, coordinate with local governments to allocate construction land in accordance with policy requirements, implement supporting conditions and funds, and reduce or waive relevant fees. Complete as soon as possible the construction of filing and petition windows and barrier-free access for persons with disabilities, as well as uniform signage for filing and petition windows and people's tribunals. Courts with construction tasks shall effectively strengthen construction fund management and cost control to avoid incurring new debts. Actively promote the resolution of historical infrastructure debts through a burden-sharing approach by the central, provincial, and county governments based on sub-projects, sub-years, and sub-proportions.

25. Further enhance the level of business equipment allocation. Conscientiously implement the Guiding Standards for Basic Business Equipment Allocation in Grassroots People's Courts (Trial), and focus on strengthening the construction of business equipment in grassroots people's courts. Higher people's courts shall, together with provincial finance departments, formulate implementation standards for business equipment allocation in grassroots people's courts in their respective regions, taking into account local actual conditions and using national standards as the basic requirements. Based on the scale of central and provincial transfer payments and the priorities of court work, formulate plans and annual implementation plans for business equipment allocation in grassroots people's courts. Grassroots people's courts shall make scientific plans based on the actual needs of trial and enforcement work, accelerate equipment updates, and realize as soon as possible the standardized allocation of professional equipment for trial courts, equipment for printing trial documents, individual equipment for judicial police, archive storage equipment, and business transportation tools. Attach great importance to the construction of safety facilities in people's tribunals, and equip them with security equipment in accordance with standards and needs as soon as possible.

26. Further promote information technology construction. In accordance with the requirements of the Decision on Comprehensively Strengthening the Information Technology Work of People's Courts issued by the Supreme People's Court, take the opportunity of the "Tianping Project" construction to strengthen the construction of information technology infrastructure. While accelerating the construction of hardware facilities such as "smart courts," focus on building local area networks covering grassroots people's courts and people's tribunals, fully apply the judicial trial information management system, and improve the information security guarantee system and related supporting facilities. Digitally input case litigation materials synchronously to form complete electronic archives, and promote the application of information technology in process management, quality evaluation, performance assessment, remote trial, etc. Further promote judicial convenience measures such as remote case filing and petition, electronic signatures, public information inquiry, and public websites. Allocate more funds, technology, and human resources to the grassroots level, and strive to improve the level of information technology construction.

27. Further improve the function and role of judicial appraisal management. Fully recognize the importance of judicial appraisal management work. Based on the needs of trial and enforcement work and in accordance with various management regulations of the Supreme People's Court, standardize the work of entrusting external evaluations, auctions, and appraisals. Grassroots people's courts with the necessary conditions shall carry out technical consultation and technical review work. Strengthen professional training for judicial technical support personnel, and continuously improve the professional capabilities of judicial appraisal management personnel.

People's courts at all levels must, from the perspective of serving the overall work of the Party and the state, fully recognize and deeply understand the importance and urgency of further strengthening grassroots basic construction in the new situation. Higher people's courts shall, in accordance with the requirements of this Opinion, promptly study and formulate specific work plans and implementation opinions that are suitable for local conditions, and promote grassroots basic construction in a planned and step-by-step manner. For new situations and new problems discovered during work, attention shall be paid to carefully analyzing the causes and countermeasures, and, when necessary, reports shall be submitted level by level to the Supreme People's Court in a timely manner.
